While you enjoy your stay in the jazz capital of the world, you’ll be conveniently located steps from the vibrant shopping, dining and entertainment of Magazine St, as well as Bourbon Street famous cafes, bistros and music clubs. Other options include crowd favorites like Chophouse New Orleans, The Tasting Room, Lilly’s Café and more, as well as Starbucks located in Sheraton Hotel, right next to your condo.

This condo is furnished with custom interiors and hand-picked furniture to make your stay one of a kind. This New Orleans style condo with exposed brick accent walls, cozy details and custom furniture will make you live like a local for the duration of your stay.

As a guest of our condo, you’ll be able to enjoy an amazing city skyline view from our roof-top patio with a spacious sitting area perfect for a small gathering or date night for two.
This building has high security with protected access.

FEATURES AND AMENITIES
• WiFi/Internet
• Air Conditioning/Heating
• Washer/Dryer
• Flat Screen TV
• City Views/Roof-Top
• And Much More

PARKING
There is no parking at the property. But you can find paid parking nearby.


THINGS TO KNOW
• We may use video surveillance in public areas.
• The number of overnight guests cannot exceed the maximum occupancy. Extra guests and visitors are not permitted without management consent. Violators will be charged $500 fine.
• The building is located on a bustling street, which can be disturbing in the evenings.
• For an additional fee, daily housekeeping services are available upon your request.

LOCAL ATTRACTIONS
• Located in the Business District
• 3-minute walking distance to the convention center.
• Mercedes-Benz Superdome is 2.4 miles.
• Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport is 14 miles away.
• Canal Place shopping mall within walking distance.

name: Hillbilly Highrise
address: 1730 Walnut Hill Lane,  Sevierville, Tennessee, United States
description:
If you're looking for the Ritz Carlton or the Four Seasons, this cabin is NOT for you, but if you're looking for a rustic country cabin with loads of country character, you've found it.  Built during the 1980's by a self-described local hillbilly for his family, this cabin is pure country. Resting on nearly an acre atop one of the higher points in Sevierville without the white-knuckle mountainside roads, the cabin boasts beautiful views including the French Broad River in the distance.
Take in the breathtaking view while you enjoy a beverage or a meal on the wrap around porch or take advantage of the spacious yard for family activity.  Inside there are two 75 inch TV's for your streaming pleasure as well as a TV in every bedroom. If you have a large group with different meal requirements, there are two full kitchens for your culinary needs.
At the end of the day, relax in a large hot tub that can accommodate most of your party.  To complete your country experience, if you listen carefully, you can even hear the occasional moo from a cow in the distance. If you want to feel country in the country instead of just luxury, this is the place for you.

It primarily serves as the home venue for the New Orleans Saints of the National Football League (NFL), and is also the home stadium for the Sugar Bowl and New Orleans Bowl in college football. Plans were drawn up in 1967 by the New Orleans modernist architectural firm of Curtis and Davis and the building opened as the Louisiana Superdome in 1975. Its steel frame covers a 13-acre (5.3 ha) expanse and the 273-foot (83 m) dome is made of a lamellar multi-ringed frame and has a diameter of 680 feet (210 m), making it the largest fixed domed structure in the world. It is adjacent to the Smoothie King Center.

name: 06 Blue - Tera hotel room
address: J.A. Abrahams Boulevard 83,  Kralendijk, Bonaire, Netherlands Antilles
description:
The 'cosy' room is ideal for anyone traveling light and focusing on getting the most out of the island but it's not without its little luxuries.

Relax to the sound of the cool Caribbean breeze blowing gently through the palm trees from the comfort of your private room.

The only thing you'll need to worry about... is if you can stay a little longer!

Bonaire is a great place to relax... but independent travelers with an adventurous spirit will get the most out of, this often-overlooked, Caribean paradise.

Famous for its impressive scuba diving the main attraction lies beneath the water. If you're not a diver, snorkeling will still let you capture a glimpse of the ocean's natural bounty. And... hiking, biking, birdwatching, kitesurfing, and windsurfing should provide something for almost everyone.

Don't forget to tour Washington Slagbaai National Park in a 4x4 for a truly wild off-road adventure and take in the breathtaking scenery of a real desert island.

With all that adventure on hand, your appetite will be well rewarded with an abundance of dining opportunities. From food trucks, serving local cuisine and international staples, to fine dining options from top international chefs. And don't forget the sundowner at many of the island's fantastic beach bars all serving great wine, craft beers, and classic Caribbean cocktails.

description:
Whether you’re seeking a championship golf resort, an intimate award-winning wedding venue in Morgantown, or perhaps just a scenic retreat where you can relax and recharge, you’ll find it all right here at Lakeview Resort Club. Our sprawling property offers guests an abundance of amenities and accommodations accented with touches of home to make your stay convenient and comfortable.

Our guests have access to two unique championship golf courses. Golfers will enjoy views of Cheat Lake and the Allegheny Mountains as they make their way through the undulating greens of our top-rated courses. The picturesque grounds of Lakeview Resort Club also provide the perfect backdrop for memorable photos.

Other features of our property include access to a world-class fitness center, onsite dining at the hotel, and an outdoor pool.

When you’re ready to venture out into Morgantown, you’ll find a welcoming town bustling with artisan shops, delicious local eateries, and countless Mountaineers cheering on the home team at West Virginia University. You’re also bound to notice the gorgeous settings that surround this Appalachian town. Outdoor enthusiasts can explore trails at nearby Coopers Rock State Forest, stroll through the arboretum, or for the adventurous-minded, you may consider a white water rafting trip in the area.

name: 2 Bedroom Apartment – Partial Ocean
address: Malecón 1,  Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco, Mexico
description:
Large suite, ideal for 6 adults.  The main bedroom is equipped with queen size bed and the second bedroom with 2 single beds.  This unit also features 2 bathrooms, a living with a sofa bed and dining room, a fully equipped kitchen, and a balcony with partial ocean views.

One Beach Street is a uniquely charming boutique hotel in the heart of the Romantic Zone also known as Old Vallarta. The hotel has just 6 stories divided into 60 comfortable suites. It overlooks the iconic Los Muertos Beach where many of the town’s early (and sometimes famous) visitors enjoyed the tranquil beach life in an authentic Mexican fishing village.  One Beach Street still continues as a venue for reviving some of the quiet but vibrant glory of Puerto Vallarta’s history and its continuing presence as one of the most beautiful beach towns in the hemisphere.

One Beach Street hotel is your point of reference for Puerto Vallarta. It was one of the first hotels built in the area.  Today, it welcomes back generations of  Vallartans ”who return each year to enjoy the relaxed interiors and rustic colonial exteriors so admired by the town’s adopted visitors. One Beach Street maintains its quaint Mexican style and is well known for having the best location for its spacious 1 and 2-bedroom suites with kitchens and balconies, ideal for those long Puerto Vallarta Vacation “getaways”. 

On the second level, this Puerto Vallarta hotel features an attractive outdoor pool with lounge chairs and umbrellas surrounding the waist-high ceramic pool for a cooling afternoon dip, perhaps before a more adventurous leap into the welcoming Los Muertos waves.

Guests enjoy the property in part because One Beach Street is within walking distance of an incredible variety of restaurants, bars, and shopping. Los Muertos Beach is known for beach clubs, some with pools, DJs, and others with small music groups playing old songs for young (and old) travelers.  The atmosphere is lively and you are guaranteed to have a memorable experience!   The Romantic Zone in Puerto Vallarta or Old Town Vallarta is a famous “people watching” location day or night. And in addition to bars and restaurants,  you can also look forward to the galleries that have become a trendy stop while visiting Puerto Vallarta and your new One Beach Street South address in Mexico.

We know you will have the “best of the essence” of Old Vallarta if you choose One Beach Street.
Guests enjoy the surrounding One Beach Street neighborhoods.  Exploring the area is fun and easy.  
We wish you a great stay and we know you will have a wonderful, memorable time at One Beach Street Zona Romantica Puerto Vallarta, your new address in Puerto Vallarta.
